references.text: The question of what a person can give in exchange for their soul points back to Isaiah's message about the worthlessness of material goods compared to the eternal value of the soul
This verse reflects the idea that there is no material compensation or ransom that can match the value of a person's life or soul, which resonates with the question asked in Mark
Jesus asks a similar question in Matthew, emphasizing the futility of gaining the whole world if it costs one their soul, which mirrors the theme in Mark
